## Scope (⛔ not a ruling)

- **Same class, not governed and optional in the same PR:** comment-only citations of the moved paths in `objectql` (`index.ts`, `summary-errors.ts`, two `plugin-audit-created-*` test comments), `driver-turso`, `metadata-protocol`, `plugin-security`, `spec` (`conversions/registry.ts`, `api/export.zod.ts`, `data/mapping.zod.ts`) and three gate-script headers. No gate reads them. They are listed so one sweep can take them, or they can be left as they are.

## Reader who acts
